title: Introduction to basics of Mohiniyattam, Episode 1

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher structures her lesson by breaking down the dance movements systematically into definitions, foot positions, and postures. She demonstrates clearly from different angles while providing detailed verbal explanations in Malayalam.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the tutorial series on Mohiniyattam.
Demonstration and explanation of the basic foot position (mandala).
Explanation of foot postures and levels (samam, padamandala, ardhamandala, mukkalmandala, muzhumandala).
Breakdown of the first adavu step with hand and eye movements.
Slow practice of the first adavu footwork.
Full demonstration combining feet, body, and hand movements in mandala.

steps_taught.name: Mandala (Foot Positions)
steps_taught.description: Triangular foot placement with heels apart and toes pointed outward.

steps_taught.name: Adavu (First Step of Taganam)
steps_taught.description: Basic stepping combined with circular hand movements and gaze.

what_works: Clear visual demonstration of foot positions and postures from close-up angles.
Structured progression from foot placement definitions to full body movement.
what_hinders: Spoken instruction is entirely in Malayalam without English subtitles for non-local learners.

quotes.text: Taganam, jaganam, dhaganam, sammishram athava vakram, tirumaana adavukal

evidence_segments.observation: Feet are placed with heels together and then toes are moved apart to form a triangular shape.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution between heels and balls of feet

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher demonstrates squatting levels in a triangular foot posture from a standing to lower sitting position.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: knee joint stress or muscular engagement

extraction.distinctive_method: Categorizing mandalas into precise fractions (quarter, half, three-quarters, full) and classifying adavus into five structural types (taganam, jaganam, dhaganam, sammishram, tirumaanam).
